original_title: Assessment completeness can mean only that all encoded rules were evaluable
v0680_disposition: Visible completeness wording has been replaced by Encoded rule coverage wording so source completeness is not implied.

original_title: Most protocols do not expose a meaningful encoding maturity status
v0680_disposition: All 376 active protocols now carry an explicit encoding maturity state. Legacy records are conservatively labelled as pending full source fidelity review.

original_title: Exact duplicate conditions can produce different action types
v0680_disposition: The audit now uses component aware conflict logic. Thirty five exact condition groups remain because different drug components legitimately require different actions. Zero exact condition conflicts remain for overlapping components.

original_title: Modified FOLFIRINOX contains a rule where the named field is ignored by engine precedence
v0680_disposition: The modified FOLFIRINOX hand foot syndrome rule now evaluates the intended field and no longer mixes condition syntaxes.

original_title: Ten select rule conditions can never be selected by the current input options
v0680_disposition: The ten stale unreachable cisplatin select rules were removed. The current integrity audit reports zero unreachable select values.

original_title: A substantial number of rules lack encoded source provenance
v0680_disposition: Every active rule now contains a source object. Legacy source objects explicitly state when full source fidelity reconciliation is still pending.

original_title: A substantial number of rules lack explicit explanations
v0680_disposition: Every active rule now contains an explanation. Source reconciled explanations remain distinct from conservative legacy explanations.

original_title: Many visible inputs are not linked to deterministic rules or required dependencies
v0680_disposition: Every visible input now has an explicit role of decision, monitoring, context or documentation. This distinguishes rule driving inputs from informative fields.

original_title: Fluoropyrimidine protocols show a residual DPD coverage review queue
v0680_disposition: The corrected breast fluoropyrimidine records were reconciled. Three residual DPD screening signals remain and require current source confirmation before any rule change.

original_title: Several HER2 and anthracycline protocols lack explicit cardiac inputs
v0680_disposition: Several corrected breast records now include cardiac context. Residual HER2 and anthracycline cardiac screening signals remain for source review.

original_title: Several taxane protocols lack explicit hepatic input coverage
v0680_disposition: The source reconciled breast taxane records now include hepatic context where required. A residual taxane hepatic screening queue remains for source review.

original_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor endocrine monitoring is not uniform
v0680_disposition: Immunotherapy endocrine screening remains deliberately optional and immunotherapy specific. Ten residual platform screening signals remain for current source review.

original_title: Three shared indication mappings remain unresolved
v0680_disposition: Primary source recheck showed that NCCP 00212 does not include Lung. The earlier audit signal was a false positive and Lung was removed. NCCP 00215 is correctly cross listed to Breast, Gynaecology, Gastrointestinal and Lung.

original_title: The Change Tracker has not yet completed its first live NCCP source comparison
v0680_disposition: The first complete live NCCP source comparison has not completed in this build environment. The clinician interface must continue to show the source check as pending until a successful source inspection occurs.

original_title: Closed change history is not yet fully persistent in the reader facing tracker
v0680_disposition: The tracker still needs a permanent reader facing archive of closed changes with reviewer, rationale and applied release.

original_title: The regimen search writes raw user query text into innerHTML
v0680_disposition: Regimen search no longer interpolates raw query text into innerHTML. Search status content is built with text nodes.

original_title: Legacy clinical screens and hard coded assessment logic remain in the production index
v0680_disposition: Legacy hidden clinical screens and hard coded historical logic remain in the production page. They are not the preferred workflow but should be removed in a future architecture cleanup.

original_title: Protocol Importer exposes internal publication mechanics and obsolete module version labels
v0680_disposition: The protocol preview remains inside developer tools and visible wording no longer exposes publication mechanics or repository instructions.

original_title: Some public assets still use historical module cache keys without the cumulative app key
v0680_disposition: All active local JavaScript and CSS assets now carry the cumulative v0.68.0 application cache key.

original_title: Source review and record identity metadata are incomplete
v0680_disposition: All 376 active protocols now carry a canonical protocol identifier. Source checked dates remain absent on 193 records and NCCP review dates remain absent on 253 records because dates were not fabricated without source confirmation.

original_title: Most regimen cards still carry nonblocking metadata review debt
v0680_disposition: Seventy regimen cards are metadata complete and 306 retain nonblocking review items, mainly duration, intent or cycle interval.

original_title: Evidence relationship taxonomy is inconsistent
v0680_disposition: The active knowledge base now uses a controlled evidence relationship taxonomy.

original_title: Duplicate evidence objects exist
v0680_disposition: All evidence records now carry canonical evidence identifiers so repeated publications share identity. Physical duplicate evidence objects remain and can be normalised later without affecting the current reader experience.

original_title: Five evidence records lack the newer structured trial fields
v0680_disposition: All 66 current evidence records now contain structured population, intervention, comparator, primary endpoint and key findings fields.

original_title: Historical knowledge data are shipped in the production site
v0680_disposition: The production site build now publishes only the current knowledge data file. Historical knowledge data remain in development history but are not shipped in the active static site.

original_title: Legacy hidden screens account for most remaining unlabelled controls
v0680_disposition: The modern generic workflow is labelled and keyboard oriented, but legacy hidden screens still account for most remaining form label debt.

original_title: Validation notes can persist locally and be exported as free text
v0680_disposition: The validation workspace carries a stronger no patient identifier warning and now requires an explicit identifier free confirmation before JSON or CSV export. Free text remains possible, so reviewer discipline is still required.

original_title: National antiemetic migration is complete in active supportive care links
v0680_disposition: National NCCP antiemetic guidance remains the active supportive care destination and the existing emetogenic traffic light model is preserved.

original_title: All active protocols point to official HSE source domains
v0680_disposition: Active source links continue to use official HSE domains. Source currency still depends on the successful change tracker inspection.

original_title: No active protocol is marked as clinically authorised
v0680_disposition: No active protocol is marked as clinically authorised. Formal validation remains pending.

original_title: The existing cumulative automated suite is green but does not prove source fidelity
v0680_status: Strengthened but not closed by automation
v0680_disposition: The cumulative automated suite is green and source fidelity sentinels were added for the high priority reconciliations. Automated testing still cannot prove full clinical source fidelity across all 376 protocols without source by source human review.
